precursors.name: Lithium hexamethyldisilazide
precursors.evidence: Lithium hexamethyldisilazide (LiHMDS) and bis(cyclopentadienyl) nickel (II) (NiCp2) were used as the lithium and nickel-containing precursors, respectively.

precursors.name: Bis(cyclopentadienyl) nickel (II)
precursors.evidence: Lithium hexamethyldisilazide (LiHMDS) and bis(cyclopentadienyl) nickel (II) (NiCp2) were used as the lithium and nickel-containing precursors, respectively.

coreactants.name: Remote oxygen plasma
coreactants.evidence: Remote oxygen plasma was used as a counter-reagent.

purge_gas.name: Argon (Ar)
purge_gas.evidence: The total oxygen plasma pulse time was 19.5 s (Ar purge during 0.5 s with flow rate 40 sccm; Ar and O2 plasma purge during 14 s with flow rate 90 sccm; Ar purge during 5 s with flow rate 40 sccm).
